definitions.explanation: Frightening someone with loud, threatening words or behaviour to make them do what one wants. A strong, formal word used in news reports and criticism of bosses, officials or gangsters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{恫喝|どうかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{市長|しちょう}→市長：12472_shichou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{恫喝|どうかつ}⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になった。
examples.english: The mayor's threatening remarks caused an uproar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{男|おとこ}→男：00561_otoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大声|おおごえ}→大声：09592_oogoe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{恫喝|どうかつ}し、⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧よう⟦{要求|ようきゅう}した→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The man shouted threats at the clerk and demanded the goods for free.

notes:
{恫|どう} is outside the everyday kanji list (news writing sometimes has どう{喝|かつ}), but the word is common in headlines; in casual speech people say ⟦{脅|おど}す→脅す：27206_odosu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恫喝|どうかつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to intimidate
- {恫喝|どうかつ}⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧: threatening remarks
- {恫喝|どうかつ}⟦{外交|がいこう}→外交：02627_gaikou⟧: diplomacy by intimidation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脅|おど}す→脅す：27206_odosu⟧: to threaten; the everyday verb
- ⟦{脅迫|きょうはく}→脅迫：27205_kyouhaku⟧: a threat, often a criminal one (blackmail, threatening letters)
- ⟦{威嚇|いかく}→威嚇：09164_ikaku⟧: a show of force meant to scare, such as a warning shot or an animal baring its teeth
